bullets.title: SHOP: Monster Q2 Beat, Strong Q3 Guide — Broad Analyst Consensus
bullets.body: Shopify reported Q2 revenue of $3.58B (+34% Y/Y) vs. Street $3.45B, GMV +31.5%, gross profit +31% Y/Y. Q3 guidance of low-30s% revenue growth (vs. Street ~27%) and FCF margin of high-teens to low-20s% broadly beat consensus. UBS maintained Neutral, flagging accelerating cloud/AI costs (+$37M YoY in Q2 COGS vs +$22M in Q1) and modest Shop Pay deceleration; stock +23% pre-market.

bullets.title: ANET: Blowout Q2 with 40% FY26 Growth Guidance; Multiple PTs Raised
bullets.body: Arista reported Q2 revenue of $3.04B (+38% Y/Y), well above consensus, with operating margin of 49.9% (+340bps vs Street). Company raised FY26 revenue growth guidance to 40% from 28%, with AI fabric revenue target ≥$3.5B. Morgan Stanley raised PT to $220, Citi to $215, JPM OW at $250; stock +10-13% pre-market. Supply constraints expected through at least 2028.

bullets.title: AMD: Strong Q2/Q3 Beat but Stock -9% on Elevated Expectations and Capex Surprise
bullets.body: AMD reported Q2 revenue of $11.54B (+50% Y/Y, +2% vs consensus) with Data Center +107% Y/Y to $6.72B. Q3 guided $13.0B ±$300M, 4% above Street. However, capex of $808M was ~2.7x consensus expectations, and results fell short of elevated buyside expectations. Management targets Data Center >100% growth in CY27 and >70% server CPU growth. Analyst PTs range from $465 (Morgan Stanley, Buy) to $580 (Mizuho, PT cut from $625), with Wolfe at $650.

bullets.title: ALAB: Big Sept-Q Guide Drives Bullish Consensus Despite Modest AH Weakness
bullets.body: Astera Labs beat June-Q at $392M revenue and guided Sept-Q to $540-560M midpoint, ~33-40% above Street. Trainium 3 content estimated $600-$1,000/XPU. UBS raised PT to $425 (Neutral), Morgan Stanley to $382. Scorpio X entering volume production, becoming largest product family. CY27 revenue estimates raised to ~$3B.

bullets.title: BKNG: Resilient 2Q, Middle East Headwinds Linger; Multiple PT Raises
bullets.body: Booking Holdings reported Q2 gross bookings of $51.0B (+8% Y/Y ex-FX, beating guidance of +2-4%), revenue $7.35B, and EBITDA $2.65B, all above consensus. Q3 guided revenue +5-7% and room nights +3-5% (slightly below Street). AI-driven referrals still <1% of room nights. Citi raised PT to $236, Mizuho to $240, OPCO to $240. Stock +9.7% pre-market.

bullets.title: NVDA: SpaceX Exclusive NVIDIA Commitment Creates Massive Demand Catalyst
bullets.body: SpaceX's Elon Musk confirmed SpaceX will build AI infrastructure exclusively on NVIDIA, scaling from 2GW compute by year-end to ~10GW by end-2027. Wolfe upgraded NVDA to Outperform, estimating SpaceX's ~6GW incremental CY27 compute translates to ~$200B in NVDA revenue at $35B/GW—exceeding Street's entire CY27 datacenter growth estimate. JPM noted SpaceX expects 'significant percentage' of NVDA GPU shipments next year.

bullets.title: DIS: Q3 EPS 12% Above Street on Parks Strength; $9B Buyback Plan
bullets.body: Disney reported Q3 adj. EPS of $2.06 (+28% Y/Y), beating FactSet $1.86. Experiences segment OI +27% Y/Y; Entertainment SVOD margins at 12.9% vs. 6.6% prior year. FY26 EPS growth guidance reaffirmed at ~12% ex-53rd week (16% reported). Raised FY26 buyback target to $9B from $8B. UBS and Citi both maintain Buy with $135 PT. Q4 headwinds from softer Moana box office and advertising market noted.

bullets.title: PINS: 2Q Beat but 3Q Deceleration Concern Weighs; Stock -9%
bullets.body: Pinterest beat 2Q revenue (+18% Y/Y) and EBITDA ($311M, +15% above consensus), with UCAN +18% Y/Y aided by AI monetization and sales force expansion. However, 3Q guidance of +13-15% is below Street's +16-17%, partly reflecting World Cup and Prime Day tailwinds reversing. Europe headwinds persist. Mizuho raised PT to $32 (OW), Citi to $27 (Neutral). Stock -9% pre-market.

bullets.title: SPOT: Morgan Stanley and JPM Reiterate OW on AI Monetization Potential
bullets.body: Spotify 2Q modestly beat but 3Q guide was below expectations on MAU adds (+5M guide vs +6.5M consensus). Morgan Stanley maintained OW at $640 PT on 20% FCF CAGR thesis; JPM maintained OW at $650 PT noting AI music tier and active advertising growth (+60% Y/Y in 2Q). Opex expected to moderate to HSD% in FY27 from high-teens in 2Q/3Q.

bullets.title: UBER: 2Q Beat on Delivery; 3Q In-Line; $10B AV Commitment
bullets.body: Uber's 2Q GMV of $58B beat guidance, up 22% FXN, with Delivery GMVs accelerating to +25% FXN. Advertising exceeded $2.5B ARR (+50% Y/Y). 3Q GMV guided $58.25-60.25B (18-22% FXN), in line with consensus. Uber committed to $10B in autonomous vehicle investments. JPM Quick Take was favorable but noted stock not yet rated.

bullets.title: PLTR: Massive 2Q Beat and Raised FY Guidance; Only Tech Stock with 0% Sub-5% Earnings Moves
bullets.body: Palantir reported Q2 revenue of $1.94B (+93% Y/Y), beating $1.8B consensus, with US commercial up 149% Y/Y. EPS $0.41 vs $0.35 consensus. Raised FY26 guidance to $8.15-8.16B from $7.65-7.66B. HSBC raised PT to $162. Jefferies noted PLTR as the only tech stock where 0% of prior earnings prints showed <5% absolute EPS move.

bullets.title: CPRI: 1Q EPS Beat Low-Quality; 2Q Guidance Well Below; UBS Negative, Citi Buy
bullets.body: Capri Holdings reported 1Q EPS of $0.67 (vs $0.40 consensus) but gross margin missed at 65.0% vs 65.7% consensus. FY27 revenue guidance cut to $3.4B from $3.525B, while 2Q EPS guided $0.20 vs $0.45 consensus. Kors revenues -7.1% Y/Y. Citi maintains Buy with $31 PT citing Kors inflection; UBS views as negative catalyst at 8x FY1 EPS.

bullets.title: VZ/T: SpaceX Satellite Mobile Plans Pressure Telcos -2-4% Pre-Market
bullets.body: SpaceX outlined plans to enter U.S. wireless market using EchoStar spectrum and Starlink Mobile V2 satellites, targeting service launch by end-2027. Plans include terrestrial buildout via femtocells on Starlink dishes. VZ -2.7%, T -1.9%, TMUS -1.3% pre-market.

bullets.title: COHR/LITE: US Ban on Chinese Optical Transceivers Drives Pre-Market Rally
bullets.body: Reports of Trump administration drafting a ban on Chinese data-center optical transceiver imports drove COHR and LITE sharply higher. Sell-side consensus views COHR and AAOI as primary beneficiaries. Edison (Jefferies) sees low risk of ban materializing due to risk of China restricting InP substrate exports; COHR separately has $50M CHIPS Act funding to quadruple InP wafer capacity at Sherman, Texas.

bullets.title: MSFT/AMZN/GOOGL: Hyperscaler AI Capex ROI Gaining Visibility; META Remains Show-Me
bullets.body: JPM: AMZN servers break even in <3 years with 5-6 year useful lives; MSFT sees ~30% ROIC on AI capex; GOOGL Cloud backlog growing faster than capex and could exceed 100% growth in 2027. Big 3 RPO ratios accelerating relative to capex. By contrast, META has no bookings, no revenue products launched, and no membership in the 'visibility club.' Google committing $150B to AI chip infrastructure.

bullets.title: MU: HBM Fully Allocated Through 2027; Strong AI Inference Demand
bullets.body: SK Hynix, Micron, and Samsung have reportedly sold out all DRAM and HBM production capacity for 2027. CXL momentum confirms memory capacity stress, broadening inference spend beyond HBM. Multiple sources flagged MU as positively positioned with high magnitude impact. HBM pricing expected to rise ~100% YoY in 2027 per GS.

bullets.title: RPRX: 2Q26 Beat; 2026 Guidance Raised to $3,450M; Citi Maintains Buy
bullets.body: Royalty Pharma 2Q26 Portfolio Receipts of $773M beat consensus by $19M; Royalty Receipts grew 14% Y/Y. 2026 guidance raised to $3,450M midpoint (+$83M vs consensus). Cystic fibrosis, Trelegy, Tremfya all missed while Tysabri and Voranigo beat. Citi maintains Buy with $66 PT.

bullets.title: NYT: Q2 Beat; Raises FY Digital Subscription Guidance
bullets.body: The New York Times reported Q2 EPS of $0.69 (vs $0.66 consensus) and revenue of $762.5M (vs $752M). Digital subscribers grew to 12.8M, with ARPU +3.1% Y/Y. Q3 digital subscription revenue guided +12-15%. Stock -9.2% pre-market, suggesting elevated expectations.

bullets.title: PSKY/WBD: PSKY Mixed Quarter; WBD Deal Trial Set March 2027
bullets.body: Paramount Skydance Q2 revenue of $6.91B barely beat estimates; DTC EBITDA guidance cut to $760M (from $1.0B prior) due to higher content amortization. Run-rate synergy guidance raised to $2.7B. WBD deal trial set for March; offer price increases $0.25/WBD share quarterly starting Sept 30. UBS cuts PT to $8 (Sell). Wolfe maintains Underperform at $10 PT citing subscale streaming and declining linear TV.
